cafe.thunderbird.way.place.text: {"lexicon":1,"id":"cafe.thunderbird.way.place","description":"A place: a stable name for a web tile that travellers can go to, whatever version of the tile is current. Ways between tiles (thunderbird.cafe, v 1): a tile lists its exits and entrances in its /ways.json; each exit names a signpost (cafe.thunderbird.way.signpost) that says where it leads; signposts point at places. Republishing a tile updates its place, so nothing pointing at the place has to change.","defs":{"main":{"type":"record","description":"The record key is the tile's short id, chosen once and never reused (e.g. \"maze\").","key":"any","record":{"type":"object","required":["tile","cid","updatedAt"],"properties":{"tile":{"type":"string","format":"at-uri","description":"The tile's current record (ing.dasl.masl)."},"cid":{"type":"string","format":"cid","description":"That record's exact version, so a host opens exactly what was meant."},"name":{"type":"string","maxLength":300,"maxGraphemes":100,"description":"A name to show on cards."},"updatedAt":{"type":"string","format":"datetime"}}}}}}

cafe.thunderbird.way.signpost.text: {"lexicon":1,"id":"cafe.thunderbird.way.signpost","description":"A signpost: where one exit of a web tile leads (ways between tiles, thunderbird.cafe, v 1; see cafe.thunderbird.way.place). The tile names its signpost in its /ways.json; only a host (the page that holds the tile) reads it, since a tile can't reach the network. Change it any time: the tile never has to be republished.","defs":{"main":{"type":"record","description":"The record key is the tile's id and the exit's id, joined by a dot (e.g. \"maze.obelisk\").","key":"any","record":{"type":"object","required":["to","updatedAt"],"properties":{"to":{"type":"array","maxLength":12,"items":{"type":"ref","ref":"#destination"},"description":"Where the exit leads. Empty: dormant, it leads nowhere yet. One: straight there. Several: the host offers a choice (\"pick a door\")."},"note":{"type":"string","maxLength":300,"maxGraphemes":100,"description":"A line the host can show, e.g. \"Under construction\"."},"updatedAt":{"type":"string","format":"datetime"}}}},"destination":{"type":"object","description":"Exactly one of place or tile.","properties":{"place":{"type":"string","format":"at-uri","description":"A place record (cafe.thunderbird.way.place): the usual case."},"tile":{"type":"string","format":"at-uri","description":"A tile record (ing.dasl.masl), for a tile with no place record."},"entrance":{"type":"string","maxLength":64,"description":"Which entrance to arrive at, as named in that tile's /ways.json."},"label":{"type":"string","maxLength":300,"maxGraphemes":100,"description":"A label for the choice, when there are several."}}}}}
